meta.name: antinet-security-scan
meta.description: 信息安全分析师与软件开发工程师在搭建文档处理流水线时，当需要拦截违规文件或外部URL，请挂载此技能作为强制前置安检，自动输出 pass/reject 判定与详细合规扫描报告，一键守住零信任安全底线。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动拦截文档流水线中的违规文件与外部URL，输出合规扫描报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在搭建文档处理流水线，需要拦截违规文件或外部URL以保障安全。
copy.tagline_en: Block bad files and URLs in document pipelines and output compliance reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build document pipelines and need to block bad files or URLs for security.

howto.what: 收到文件或外部 URL 时先做安检，输出 pass 或 reject 判定、含黑名单命中与风险等级的扫描报告，并生成 trace_id 留痕。
howto.when: 当文档处理流水线需要拦截违规文件或外部 URL 时触发，由锦衣卫 Worker 在收到文件/URL 时作为第一道闸门接管。

say.note: 返回 pass 或 reject 与扫描报告

say.text: 检查这个 URL 是否违规：https://example.com/doc
用 policy_ref 覆盖默认策略，重扫该文件
say.note: 替换合规规则集后重新判定

howto.what_en: On receiving a file or external URL, it runs a security check first, outputs a pass or reject verdict plus a scan report with blacklist hits and risk level, and writes a trace_id for provenance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a document pipeline must block non-compliant files or external URLs; the jinyiwei Worker calls it on each incoming file or URL as the first gate.

say_en.note: Returns a pass or reject verdict with a scan report

say_en.text: Check whether this URL is non-compliant: https://example.com/doc
Override the default policy with this policy_ref and rescan the file
say_en.note: Swaps the rule set, then re-judges
